Waterway information - Oceanographic Moorings - West Coast Vancouver Island South
2 subsurface oceanographic moorings have been deployed 1 meter from the sea floor off Estevan Point at 49 19.637N 126 34.985W and in the Soquel Bank off Pachena Point at 48 41.534N 125 06.415W.
